title: Count and Say

solutions.optimal:
class Solution:
    def countAndSay(self, n: int) -> str:
        term = "1"
        for _ in range(n - 1):
            pieces = []
            count = 0
            prev = term[0]
            for ch in term + "#":  # Sentinel differs from every digit.
                if ch == prev:
                    count += 1
                else:
                    pieces.append(str(count))
                    pieces.append(prev)
                    prev = ch
                    count = 1
            term = ''.join(pieces)
        return term
